items.name: Aquático Aclimação Open 2025

venue.name: Clube Aquático da Aclimação
venue.address: R. Dona Brígida, 375 - Vila Mariana, São Paulo - SP, 04110-061

items.information:
# Português:

Pagamento da taxa via PIX: 282.098.828-80 (CPF)

Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br
**Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor, caso o comprovante não seja enviado no email acima com o nome do competidor, sua inscrição não será aceita.**
Sócios do Clube Aquático da Aclimação terão 50% de desconto na inscrição e terão de informar no campo de comentários que são sócios e comprovar no dia da competição.
Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade.
Inscrições no local serão aceitas com uma taxa de inscrição de R$ 30,00. Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade. Caso todas as vagas sejam preenchidas na WCA, as inscrições no local serão suspensas de acordo com a [regra 5.2.1 da Política de Requisitos de Competição da WCA (WCRP)](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf).
**Será permitido a entrada de 1 acompanhante por competidor.**

# English:

Payment with PIX method: 282.098.828-80 (CPF)

Send the payment proof to E-mail: helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br
**Send the receipt with the competitor's name, if the receipt is not sent in the email above with the competitor's name, your registration will not be accepted.**
Members of the Aclimação Aquatic Club will have a 50% discount on registration and will have to inform in the comments field that they are members and prove it on the day of the competition.
To register on site, please bring a document that proves your identity.
On the spot registrations will be accepted with a base registration fee of R$ 30,00. To register on the spot, please bring a document that proves your identity. If all WCA subscriptions are filled, on-site registration will be suspended according to [rule 5.2.1 of WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP)](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf).
**One guest per competitor will be allowed.**

items.name: More Cubes Karori 2025
items.information:
More Cubes Karori 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

#### SacCubing returns with our 20th iteration! Make sure to sign up early to reserve your spot!

*  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
* We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
* All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.

items.name: CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic Quiet Championship 2025
items.information: This is the Mid-Atlantic championship for the quiet events only (3x3-5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, 3x3 Fewest Moves). However, anyone can compete regardless of whether they live in the Mid-Atlantic region or not. See more information on the [Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MidAtlanticQuietChampionship2024#48070-championship-eligibility) tab.

items.name: DFW Qualifier 2025
items.information:
Note: This competition is on a Sunday.

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQualifier2025#54274-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQualifier2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue, however it is permitted in the foyer outside the expo hall.***

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
